id: title:Gilbert09:stop retrying a disabled database endpoint

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a permanent, actionable error message for a specific database provider failure mode, distinguishing it from quota exhaustion.
review.reason: The chunk explicitly adds a new non-retryable error entry for 'The endpoint has been disabled' and its corresponding test. This represents a substantive, bounded correctness and reliability improvement: it distinguishes a permanent failure from a recoverable one, preventing users or downstream systems from retrying an unavailable endpoint. While the chunk lacks the implementation,
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the clear intent and test addition, but the absence of the actual implementation and updated matching logic prevents a higher tier. The benefit is demonstrated by the existence of the test and the error entry, not by the execution of the new behavior.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the new error message or the updated matching logic; it only shows the addition of the error message entry and the corresponding test. Without the implementation, the tier cannot be assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a new non-retryable error entry for 'The endpoint has been disabled' and a corresponding test.
